summary: V0.2 Production Engine fully verified. Ran full regression (24 V0.1 tests) + wrote 24 new Production Engine tests covering config, fiery-status, happy path (landscape/portrait/double-sided/trim-expand), all 12 STOP codes (MISSING_BACK, WRONG_DIMENSIONS, WRONG_ASPECT_RATIO, UNSAFE_SAFE_AREA, PROTECTED_CONTENT_REVIEW, PDF_EXPORT_FAILED, TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND, JOB_AMBIGUOUS, DEVICE_OFFLINE, FIERY_UNAVAILABLE, ACTIVE_STOP enforcement), AI-cannot-authorize gate (HTTP 403 + policy DENY AI_CANNOT_AUTHORIZE_PRODUCTION), human authorization gate (HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED -> PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED, PRINT never exposed), wrong tenant/location (400), recipe version pinning (v1) and audit chain (chain_valid true, every entry carries policy_decision + recipe_version), idempotency key on FIERY_PREPARATION, Edge protocol (register token+REGISTERING, seeded P2G-LONDON-EDGE-01 OFFLINE, heartbeat->ONLINE, actions poll), and AI Recipe Import safety (always DRAFT + provenance + extraction_model; incomplete content -> CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED). Result: 47 passed, 1 skipped. Frontend E2E via Playwright verified: honesty banners (REAL_FIERY_BACKEND=NOT_IMPLEMENTED, PRINT locked), create job -> attach artwork -> Advance through all 12 stepper states -> Authorize -> PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED with ORIGINAL/WORKING_COPY/PRINT_READY/PRODUCTION_OUTPUT lineage and 12 audit entries. STOP variant (missing_back) shows red STOP banner (MISSING_BACK) and disables Advance. Recipes page shows 1 ACTIVE badge (RECIPE-BC-LONDON-V1) + 3 DRAFT badges. Edge Agents page shows honesty banner and P2G-LONDON-EDGE-01 as OFFLINE. Regression pages (Dashboard, Orders, Products, Machines, Exceptions) load without error.

minor.issue: test_exception_resolve becomes SKIP after first successful run because seeded exceptions were mutated in-place (no per-run cleanup). Not a bug, but test isolation could be improved by creating a fresh exception in the fixture.

critical_code_review_comments: production.py: /api/production/edge/agents leaks agent 'token' from DB. Currently projection excludes token (good). Verified.
production.py: 'ai_model' is hardcoded to 'openai/gpt-5.4' when ai_actor=true — cosmetic; consider taking it from opts.

production.py::advance: after STOP occurs during a state, the return path uses the pre-computed 'decision' (which was ALLOW) as the policy field — potentially confusing but subsequent /advance correctly returns DENY ACTIVE_STOP (verified in test).
server.py: import_recipe uses model string 'openai/gpt-5.4' — knowledge-cutoff-safe? Confirmed working with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (test passes). Just make sure this model exists via emergent proxy.
EdgeAgents.jsx: liveAgents block briefly shows 'No agents registered' during initial react-query fetch — minor UX flash; consider a small isLoading state (non-blocking).
seed_data_creation: Test uses backend dev-artwork endpoint to synthesize deterministic PDFs; created TEST_ prefixed orders/products/machines/recipes cleaned in-test; registered TEST-EDGE-AGENT-99 (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: 48 backend tests exist (24 V0.1 in backend_test.py + 24 V0.2 in test_production.py). Both files are the regression suite. Production engine collections: prod_jobs, prod_files, prod_audit, prod_idempotency, prod_edge_agents, prod_edge_actions. Use dev-artwork with variant param to inject test artwork. Simulate faults via advance body {"simulate":"CODE"}.
